domains.name: Agent Session
domains.description: Core agent conversation lifecycle: creating sessions, streaming LLM turns, ingesting events, rendering chat history, and managing session state across native and CLI agent backends.

flows.name: Session Lifecycle
flows.description: Create, configure, launch, pause, resume, and terminate agent sessions with model/provider selection and workspace binding.

steps.name: Create Session
steps.description: User configures agent type, model, repo context, and launch parameters via SessionCreator; validates prerequisites and resolves workspace.

steps.name: Launch Agent
steps.description: Dispatch session to the Rust backend via Tauri RPC, spawn the agent process (native or CLI sidecar), and establish the sync channel.

steps.name: Manage Session State
steps.description: Track active/pinned sessions, switch between sessions, evict idle sessions, and persist session metadata to SQLite.

steps.name: Session History
steps.description: Query, group, and display past sessions with statistics, subagent trees, and cross-source import (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf).

flows.name: Event Pipeline
flows.description: Ingest raw LLM activity chunks, normalize into SessionEvents, store in per-session EventStores, and bridge to SQLite cache for persistence.

steps.name: Ingest Activity Chunks
steps.description: Receive raw streaming chunks from the agent runtime, consolidate partial tokens, normalize tool calls, and merge into the event store.

steps.name: Sync Channel
steps.description: Bridge between Rust EventStore and React UI via batched change notifications, adapter-specific streaming parsers, and snapshot materialization.

steps.name: Cache Persistence
steps.description: Save and load events to/from SQLite cache with CachedEvent conversion, payload compaction, and turn-based pagination.

steps.name: Extract Rendering Data
steps.description: Pre-compute rendering props from events: diff parsing, file references, shell output formatting, search results, and tool call cards.

flows.name: Chat Interaction
flows.description: User-facing chat panel: composing messages, rendering conversation history, handling interactive events (approvals, questions), and displaying tool call results.

steps.name: Compose Message
steps.description: Rich input area with @-mentions, slash commands, file attachments, image paste, code citations, voice input, and context pills.

steps.name: Render Chat History
steps.description: Virtualized chat list with turn grouping, pagination, search, pinned headers, and group-chat view for multi-agent sessions.

steps.name: Display Tool Blocks
steps.description: Render agent tool calls as structured blocks: code diffs, file reads, shell commands, web searches, canvas previews, and subagent activity.

steps.name: Handle Interactive Events
steps.description: Process user-approval requests, ask-question prompts, mode-switch proposals, and plan approval gates during agent execution.

steps.name: Plan Execution
steps.description: Create, display, approve, and track agent plans with todo checklists, step-by-step progress, and plan content persistence.

flows.name: Session Replay
flows.description: Replay past sessions as time-sequenced visualizations in the Simulator engine with playback controls, event filtering, and multi-session grid views.

steps.name: Simulator Engine
steps.description: Core replay runtime: event indexing, time-based navigation, playback speed control, autoplay behavior, and follow-mode across subagents.

steps.name: Grid Layout
steps.description: Multi-cell grid displaying parallel subagent activity with dock controls, file tabs, caption bar, and status bar.

steps.name: Event Routing
steps.description: Route events to dock panels (chat, editor, terminal, browser) and filter by type, visibility, and subagent membership.

domains.name: Agent Organization
domains.description: Multi-agent orchestration: defining agent teams (orgs), running coordinated org executions with task graphs, inter-agent messaging, member interventions, and automation workflows.

flows.name: Agent Definition
flows.description: Define, configure, and manage agent definitions (built-in, CLI, custom) with models, tools, rules, skills, MCP servers, and runtime limits.

steps.name: Manage Agent Definitions
steps.description: CRUD for agent definitions: built-in SDE/OS agents, CLI agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex), and custom agents with personality, sub-agents, and tool configuration.

steps.name: Configure Agent Tools
steps.description: Assign built-in tools, MCP servers, skills, skillsets, and workspace settings to agents; manage tool matrices and safety policies.

steps.name: Configure Agent Models
steps.description: Select primary/fallback models, set runtime limits (turns, tokens, time), and configure reliability/retry behavior per agent.

flows.name: Org Execution
flows.description: Run multi-agent organizations: task decomposition, dependency graphs, atomic claim-based task assignment, inter-agent messaging, and coordinated shutdown.

steps.name: Create Org Run
steps.description: Initialize an Agent Org run with entry mode, parent session, and worker session discovery; track lifecycle (Running/Paused/Completed/Failed/Cancelled).

steps.name: Task Management
steps.description: Create tasks with dependency graphs (cycle detection, blocker resolution), atomic try_claim for worker assignment, and status tracking (Pending/InProgress/Completed).

steps.name: Agent Messaging
steps.description: Typed inter-agent inbox with message kinds (Plain, ShutdownRequest, PlanApproval, TaskAssigned, MemberTerminated) and SQLite-backed persistence.

steps.name: User Intervention
steps.description: Pause inbox drain for direct user-agent conversation, TTL-based auto-resume, and group-chat UI for observing multi-agent collaboration.

flows.name: Automation Workflow
flows.description: Visual workflow editor for defining automated agent sequences with branching, actions, and scheduled triggers.

steps.name: Workflow Editor
steps.description: Drag-and-drop visual editor for creating automation workflows with action nodes, branch labels, end blocks, and collapsible sections.

steps.name: Org Chart
steps.description: Visual org chart showing agent hierarchy, roles, and relationships within an Agent Organization.

steps.name: Routine Scheduling
steps.description: Background scheduler polling cron/one-time triggers with catch-up policy and idempotency keys to prevent double-firing.

domains.name: Project Management
domains.description: Issue tracking and project orchestration: work items with status/priority/assignee, kanban boards, Gantt charts, calendar views, git-synced projects, Linear integration, and agent-driven work item execution.

flows.name: Work Item Lifecycle
flows.description: Create, assign, schedule, execute, and review work items with agent orchestration, automated PR creation, and review workflows.

steps.name: Create Work Item
steps.description: Create work items with title, description, status, priority, labels, assignee, due dates, milestones, and delegation configuration.

steps.name: Agent Workflow Execution
steps.description: Orchestrate work items through agent phases (coding, SDE, review, follow-up) with linked sessions, file changes, test results, and PR status tracking.

steps.name: Manage Work Item Properties
steps.description: Edit status, priority, assignees, reviewers, dates, labels, planning estimates, and delegations via property panels and context menus.

steps.name: Auto Review
steps.description: Detect stale sessions, trigger automated code review, and manage reviewer configuration for agent-produced work.

flows.name: Project Views
flows.description: Multiple visualization modes for project data: kanban boards, list views, Gantt charts, calendar, and task replay timelines.

steps.name: Kanban Board
steps.description: Drag-and-drop kanban with columns by status, task cards with priority/impact indicators, and filtering by labels/assignees.

steps.name: Gantt Chart
steps.description: Timeline visualization with task bars, dependency lines, milestones, zoom levels, and drag-to-reschedule.

steps.name: Calendar View
steps.description: Day/week/month calendar showing work item events with spanning event cards and navigation controls.

flows.name: Project Sync
flows.description: Synchronize project data across local storage, git-based project records, hosted API, and external integrations (Linear).

steps.name: Git Sync
steps.description: Persist project records as files in the repository, sync changes bidirectionally, and review git-synced modifications.

steps.name: Linear Integration
steps.description: Import Linear projects and issues, map workflow states, sync bidirectionally, and manage Linear-specific settings.

steps.name: Team Collaboration
steps.description: Real-time project collaboration via Supabase sync, team member management, and org-level project settings.

domains.name: Developer Workstation
domains.description: IDE-like workspace environment: code editor with syntax highlighting, integrated terminal, embedded browser, file explorer, git source control, search, and diagnostic panels.

flows.name: Code Editing
flows.description: CodeMirror-based editor with syntax highlighting, git blame, diff viewer, conflict resolution, minimap, and agent-driven file changes.

steps.name: Editor Core
steps.description: CodeMirror editor with language extensions, custom linter integration (ESLint, LSP), copy-file-ref extension, and large file handling.

steps.name: Diff Viewer
steps.description: Unified and split diff views with syntax highlighting, cherry-pick selection, progressive rendering, and GitHub-style diff display.

steps.name: File Management
steps.description: File tree explorer with multi-root support, inline rename, context menus, drag-drop, and file content caching with mtime tracking.

flows.name: Terminal Management
flows.description: Integrated terminal with PTY process management, shell integration, multiple sessions, and agent-driven command execution.

steps.name: Terminal Core
steps.description: xterm.js-based interactive terminal with PTY lifecycle, resize handlers, theme integration, and shell detection.

steps.name: Shell Integration
steps.description: Shell integration addon for command detection, process reconciliation, output formatting, and file link resolution.

steps.name: Output Channels
steps.description: Structured output channels for git operations, task runners, and file watcher integrations with formatted display.

flows.name: Git Source Control
flows.description: Full git workflow: staging, committing, branching, merging, rebasing, stashing, push/pull, conflict resolution, and PR management.

steps.name: Staging and Commit
steps.description: Stage files, compose commit messages (with AI generation), commit changes, and manage the commit form state.

steps.name: Branch Operations
steps.description: Create, checkout, delete, and merge branches; handle detached HEAD, protected branch dialogs, and remote branch sync.

steps.name: Git Status Monitoring
steps.description: Real-time git status via WebSocket events, file watcher registration, multi-repo status context, and auto-fetch.

steps.name: Blame and History
steps.description: Git blame annotations, file history timeline, commit dot graph, and contributor statistics.

flows.name: Search and Navigation
flows.description: Code search (regex, semantic, symbol), code map exploration, spotlight navigation, and file indexing.

steps.name: Code Search
steps.description: Regex search, semantic search, and symbol search across the workspace with ignore pattern filtering and merkle-based incremental indexing.

steps.name: Code Map
steps.description: Workspace-level code map with node details, relationship exploration, and search panel for navigating codebase structure.

steps.name: Auto Indexing
steps.description: Background file indexing with file watcher integration, incremental updates, and workspace status tracking.

flows.name: Embedded Browser
flows.description: Built-in browser for web previews, OAuth capture, and agent browser automation within the workstation.

steps.name: Browser Sessions
steps.description: Manage browser pane sessions with URL navigation, webview lifecycle, native frame anchoring, and new-window handling.

steps.name: OAuth Capture
steps.description: Capture OAuth tokens from embedded webviews for CLI agent authentication (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Kiro).

steps.name: Browser Automation
steps.description: Agent-driven browser automation with context adaptation, URL input, and session-level webview management.

domains.name: Platform Infrastructure
domains.description: Cross-cutting platform services: authentication, API key management, model catalog, MCP server management, skills, settings, integrations, database connections, containers, and application lifecycle.

flows.name: Authentication and Key Vault
flows.description: User authentication via Supabase, API key storage and validation, model account management, and hosted service key provisioning.

steps.name: User Authentication
steps.description: Login/logout via Supabase auth, token refresh, auth guards for routes, and session expiration handling.

steps.name: Key Vault Management
steps.description: Store and validate API keys for multiple providers, manage accounts with enabled models, and display key status with reference pricing.

steps.name: Model Catalog
steps.description: Unified model catalog with alias registry, pair compatibility checks, provider-specific capabilities, and model wiki.

flows.name: Integrations Hub
flows.description: Central management for MCP servers, skills, built-in tools, external connections, databases, language servers, and dev tools.

steps.name: MCP Servers
steps.description: Install, configure, enable/disable MCP servers with inline expanded cards, detail views, and external import from CLI agent configs.

steps.name: Skills Management
steps.description: Browse, install, edit, and manage agent skills with the skills hub, skill editor, and external import from Cursor plugins.

steps.name: Rules, Memory, and Evolution
steps.description: Agent rules (markdown, automation), workspace memory browser, and agent learning/evolution tracking.

steps.name: Database Connections
steps.description: Configure and connect to databases (SQLite, Supabase, Turso, Neon, Postgres, MySQL) with SQL editor and query history.

steps.name: External Connections
steps.description: Manage external service connections, channels with gateway agents, and sync connections (GitHub, Linear).

flows.name: Settings and Appearance
flows.description: Application settings with JSON schema-driven UI, theme customization, background images, keyboard shortcuts, and notification preferences.

steps.name: Settings UI
steps.description: Schema-driven settings renderer with sections, fields, slots, and parity enforcement between schema and UI manifest.

steps.name: Theme and Appearance
steps.description: Global themes, primary colors, background images with luminance sampling, glass material effects, and edge reflection.

steps.name: Keyboard Shortcuts
steps.description: Configurable keyboard shortcut registry with category-based organization, display formatting, and global shortcut handlers.

flows.name: Application Lifecycle
flows.description: App bootstrap, repo selection, setup walkthrough, deep links, updates, diagnostics, and cross-window synchronization.

steps.name: App Bootstrap
steps.description: Application initialization: providers setup, deferred services, first paint signal, shell effects, and E2E bootstrap mode.

steps.name: Setup Walkthrough
steps.description: First-run onboarding wizard with steps for welcome, repo selection, GitHub connection, theme selection, dev passport, and completion.

steps.name: Repo and Workspace Management
steps.description: Repository selection, workspace binding, multi-repo support, container engines, and environment scanning.

steps.name: Diagnostics and Monitoring
steps.description: Runtime diagnostics, RAM history tracking, network monitoring, LSP diagnostics, and system dependency checks.
